title: fix: always sync Gen secrets after production deploy
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary
- Restores full Gen secret synchronization after every production Gen deploy.
- Removes the two opt-in Gen secret inputs and the OpenRouter-only special path added by #14825.
- Leaves actual secret additions and rotations behind the existing approval policy; unchanged versioned values reconcile automatically.

## Test plan
- git diff --check
- actionlint reports only the existing concurrency.queue warning, identical on main

gist.headline: Secrets follow the deploy
gist.blurb: Every production Gen deploy now brings its full secret garden along for the ride. New and rotated secrets still wait behind the approval gate; the rest quietly stay in sync.
gist.summary: Production Gen deployments now automatically reconcile all existing versioned Gen secrets, replacing the opt-in inputs and OpenRouter-only synchronization path introduced in #14825.
gist.impact: Users get more reliable Gen production deployments because unchanged secret versions are synchronized on every deploy, while new secret additions and rotations remain approval-controlled.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful release gardener carrying a watering can between a cozy production server greenhouse and a row of labeled secret jars, with every healthy code-plant receiving the same gentle sync. A small CRT monitor robot can confirm the synchronized deploy, while approval-gated new seeds sit safely behind a tiny garden gate.
